test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

They requested to close the door if he was feeling cold.

options.text: He said, "Please closed the door if you are feeling cold."
He said, "Please close the door if you are feeling cold.
He said, "Please close the door if you is feeling cold."
He said, "Please close the door if feel cold."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** They requested to close the door if he was feeling cold.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"requested to close the door" becomes "Please close the door"**
 
 
• The word "requested" is converted into the polite expression "Please" to match the direct speech format.
 
• The verb "close" is retained in its base form.
 
 
 
• **"if he was feeling cold" becomes "if you are feeling cold"**
 
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "you" to match the direct speech pronoun change.
 
• Verb "was" is changed to "are" to match the present tense in direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Please" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause precedes the quoted speech and is followed by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He said, "Please close the door if you are feeling cold.""*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He said, "Please closed the door if you are feeling cold."" 

 
 
• The word "closed" is grammatically incorrect as it must be in the base form "close" in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He said, "Please close the door if you is feeling cold."" 
 
 
• The verb "is" is incorrect as it must be "are" to match the subject "you" in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He said, "Please close the door if feel cold."" 
 
 
• The clause is incomplete as it omits the subject "you" before "feel cold."
